note: Fallback inventory of the engineering check code (FR-INT-14, TR-INT-14). One entry per default, clamp, nearest-row lookup or catch-all branch of an engineering input. policy: refuse | default-and-report | conservative-neighbour | pending. A non-pending entry names the unit test (relative to the repo root) that proves it and that test must contain the entry id; a pending entry carries a reason and no test. The source scan of tests/unit/contract/fallbackInventory.test.ts catches new unlisted patterns; its allowlist is fallback_scan_allowlist.json.

entries.input: steel grade text (was: any unparseable grade checked as S355)
governing thickness (was: ignored, t <= 40 mm value for every thickness)
bolt diameter (was: snapped to the nearest stress-area table size)
road design speed above 120 km/h (was: clamped to the 120 km/h row)
road design speed between table rows (next higher row, named in the summary)
drainage criteria left out (rainfall intensity, velocity limits, cover, depth ratio, manhole K, freeboard, 5 min inlet time)
pipe service text: a service not matching the gas / air / steam regex takes the water-filled span column
entries.reason: free-text service; the fallback is on the conservative side (water-filled spans are the shorter ones). Replacing the regex by an enum changes the add_pipe_support / pipe service model, larger than this fix: planned with the piping service enum.

entries.input: crane wheel base left out (3000 mm)
entries.reason: documented default in the wheelBase param description but not yet listed in the result data.defaulted of check_crane_runways / check_portal_frames.

entries.input: minimum cut piece rule left out of the project rule set (no minimum: only pieces of 0 mm or less are flagged)
entries.reason: an absent optional rule disables the minimum-cut-length check without being reported in the result; it should add an info finding naming the unset rule. Planned with the fabrication rule-set work.

entries.input: frame loads left out (deadLoad 0.5, snowLoad 0.8, windPressure 0 kN/m2): echoed in the summary but not listed in data.defaulted
entries.reason: check_portal_frames / design_portal_frames / check_foundations print the loads used in the summary; listing them in data.defaulted like boltClass needs the shared load shape and its tests reworked. Planned under INT-14.

entries.input: numeric ?? / || defaults and destructuring defaults in the domain-* files outside the check / design / analysis name tier (recorded as a per-file hit count)
entries.reason: the scan was extended to every non-test source file of packages/domain-*: these hits are ratcheted per file (a new one fails the scan) but were not individually reviewed. Only the grade fallbacks (S355 and any grade parser) were reviewed; review the rest and promote engineering inputs to refuse / default-and-report entries.

entries.input: steel grade of generated rack / platform members (was: the unparseable text "steel", checked as S355)
entries.reason: generated members now store the explicit grade S355 (visible in the model, checked like any stored grade) but add_pipe_rack / add_access_platform have no grade parameter and derived members cannot be edited; add a steelGrade field to the rack and platform specs.
